text = 'aaa bbb ccc'
width = 7

lines = []
cur = ""

words = text.split()

for w in words:
    extra = len(w) + (1 if cur else 0)
    fits = len(cur) + extra <= width
    
    print(f"w='{w}', extra={extra}, cur='{cur}', len(cur)+extra={len(cur)+extra}, width={width}, fits={fits}")
    
    if not fits:
        print(f"  -> Appending '{cur}' to lines")
        lines.append(cur)
        cur = w
    else:
        print(f"  -> Extending cur to '{cur} {w}'")
        cur = f"{cur} {w}" if cur else w

print(f"\nFinal cur: '{cur}'")
if cur:
    print(f"Appending final '{cur}' to lines")
    lines.append(cur)

print(f"\nResult: {lines}")
